description: Create a new password-protected temporary WordPress site. No account needed. Returns the site name, a token (save it, it is shown once), the visitor login, the WordPress admin login and a claim link for the person.

name.description: a short hint for the address, e.g. "bakery"

ref.description: an Oxyforge affiliate code, only if the person gave you one (it goes on the claim link so their sign-up is credited)

site_password.description: visitor password, at least 8 characters; one is made up when left out

name: create_site
title: Create a WordPress site
